sections.text_helper: Section 57.8.16 "TIMx input selection register (TIMx_TISEL)(x = 16 to 17)" in chapter 57 (General purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2920.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x5C
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:4 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 3:0 TI1SEL[3:0]: selects tim_ti1_in[15:0] input
0000: TIMx_CH1 input (tim_ti1_in0)
0001: tim_ti1_in1
...
1111: tim_ti1_in15
Refer to Section57.4.2: TIM15/TIM16/TIM17 pins and internal signals for interconnects list.
